title: Verify: objectClick event selects the object and unsubscribes on unmount
summary: Unit tests emit objectClick on the real bus with Phaser mocked.
description: Write tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx proving App reacts to objectClick and cleans its listener.
acceptance_criteria: Given App is mounted after Begin, when objectClick with id bookshelf is emitted, then Inspect, Push, Search and Leave buttons show.
Given App is unmounted, when objectClick is emitted, then no ActionMenu appears and no error is logged.
technical_constraints: Mock createGame and BootScene; use the real events module

steps.action: Create a test file with the same createGame/BootScene mocks and ResizeObserver stub as appPhaserHost.test.tsx; render <App/>, click Begin, wrap phaserToReact.emit('objectClick',{id:'bookshelf'}) in act(), and assert buttons named Inspect, Push, Search and Leave exist; add a second test that spies console.error, unmounts, emits again inside act, and asserts console.error was not called and no 'Inspect' button exists.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx
cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx
